title: Investors flee to Magnificent Seven stocks due to the US-led war in Iran; tech is up 1.5% from February 27, the only S&P 500 sector to rise since the strikes (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Investors flee to Magnificent Seven stocks due to the US-led war in Iran; tech is up 1.5% from February 27, the only S&P 500 sector to rise since the strikes — Megacap companies previously out of favour now seen as ‘safety assets’ — Investors have sought shelter from the turmoil …
contentText:
Financial Times :

Investors flee to Magnificent Seven stocks due to the US-led war in Iran; tech is up 1.5% from February 27, the only S&P 500 sector to rise since the strikes   —  Megacap companies previously out of favour now seen as ‘safety assets’  —  Investors have sought shelter from the turmoil …
